brief.summary: Equity futures pointed higher, led by tech, while front-end yields held near 4.74% and long-end yields crept up, leaving the curve slightly steeper. Credit spreads in AI/data-center debt widened and oil stayed elevated. The Fed was widely expected to hold today, with a hawkish tone and a December hike still priced; less than 10% odds of a hike today. The dominant narrative was an AI capex boom colliding with financing competition and ROI doubts, alongside rising Iran strike risk. Tone was cautiously positive on earnings but neutral overall, with investors wary of Fed communication and credit stress.
notable_quotes: Are we in the bubble? My answer is always, of course we are, and the question is just how close are we to it popping?
